note: Hutong Dubai has no agreed GA4 booking target, so this report shows volume, month on month and year on year only. October took 334 GA4 bookings on the create path, 20.1% below September and 49.1% below last October. All three months are rebuilt on the create path basis, so September reads 418 here rather than the 452 published on the September page, which was built on the older all paths basis before the 12 October 2026 boundary. The year on year fall is substantially measurement rather than trade. The GA4 booking event has been under recording at Hutong Dubai from about 12 October, so October is a part broken month: GA4 captured 0.77 of SevenRooms website bookings across October against 1.12 in October 2025. On SevenRooms, which is unaffected by our own site tagging, website bookings created were 435 against 588 last October, down 26.0%, and all channels 1,364 against 1,843, down 26.0%. So read the 49.1% as the tag and a real but smaller decline together, and treat 334 as a floor.
